verdict.rationale: GitLab documents turning the Agent Platform on or off for top-level groups on GitLab.com and for instances on Self-Managed. It also documents Allow, Ask, and Deny policies for agent tools, enforced at execution time for all connecting clients. Human-in-the-loop approvals back up the 'ask' mode. Missing for 10: evidence of per-subgroup or per-agent toggles (only top-level groups and instances are documented), in-depth policy configuration docs beyond one-line claims, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can enable or disable AI agents per group or instance and set allow, ask, or deny policies for the tools they can use
